sequence.en: Do you have a lunch buddy?

sequence.cn: 搭子，就是只在一件事上一起的朋友。
sequence.py: Dāzi, jiù shì zhǐ zài yí jiàn shì shàng yìqǐ de péngyou.
sequence.en: A 搭子 is a friend you share exactly one activity with.

sequence.cn: 吃饭有饭搭子，旅游有旅游搭子，健身有健身搭子。
sequence.py: Chīfàn yǒu fàn dāzi, lǚyóu yǒu lǚyóu dāzi, jiànshēn yǒu jiànshēn dāzi.
sequence.en: Meals have meal buddies, trips have travel buddies, the gym has gym buddies.

sequence.cn: 我和同事小李，做了三年的饭搭子。
sequence.py: Wǒ hé tóngshì Xiǎo Lǐ, zuò le sān nián de fàn dāzi.
sequence.en: My coworker Xiao Li and I were lunch buddies for three years.

sequence.cn: 每天十二点，他敲敲我的桌子，我们就下楼。
sequence.py: Měi tiān shí'èr diǎn, tā qiāoqiao wǒ de zhuōzi, wǒmen jiù xiàlóu.
sequence.en: Every day at twelve he'd tap my desk, and down we'd go.

sequence.cn: 吃完饭各回各的工位，从来不加微信。
sequence.py: Chī wán fàn gè huí gè de gōngwèi, cónglái bù jiā wēixìn.
sequence.en: After eating we each went back to our own desk — we never added each other on WeChat.

sequence.cn: 上个月他要换工作了，我们最后一次去那家面馆。
sequence.py: Shàng ge yuè tā yào huàn gōngzuò le, wǒmen zuìhòu yí cì qù nà jiā miànguǎn.
sequence.en: Last month he was changing jobs, so we went to that noodle shop one last time.

sequence.cn: 他放下筷子说：其实这家的面，我一直觉得一般。
sequence.py: Tā fàngxià kuàizi shuō: qíshí zhè jiā de miàn, wǒ yìzhí juéde yìbān.
sequence.en: He put down his chopsticks: honestly, I've never thought the noodles here were any good.

sequence.cn: 我愣了一下：我也是，我以为是你喜欢。
sequence.py: Wǒ lèng le yíxià: wǒ yě shì, wǒ yǐwéi shì nǐ xǐhuan.
sequence.en: I froze: me neither — I thought you were the one who liked it.
